reforms.description: The 2016 federal budget announced significant investments to make post-secondary education more affordable for students from low- and middle-income families, including increased Canada Student Grants amounts and expanded eligibility thresholds.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Increased access to education enhances the skill level of the workforce, which can lead to higher productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The government now provides more information on fields of study and occupational outcomes.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant investment in human capital, addressing barriers to education and aiming to improve the overall skill level of the population, which is crucial for long-term economic growth.
reforms.source_quote: The 2016 federal budget announced significant investments to make post-secondary education more affordable for students from low- and middle-income families.

reforms.description: The federal government proposed a substantial increase in funding of CAD 8.4 billion over the next five years to improve the socio-economic conditions facing Indigenous Peoples, focusing on education, training, and infrastructure.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investing in education and infrastructure for Indigenous Peoples is expected to enhance human capital and promote inclusive economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The budget includes a significant increase in funding for Indigenous Peoples.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a major investment aimed at addressing long-standing socio-economic disparities, with potential long-term impacts on growth and inclusivity.
reforms.source_quote: The budget proposes a substantial increase in funding of CAD 8.4 billion over the next five years to improve the sub-standard socio-economic conditions facing Indigenous Peoples.

reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This initiative aims to enhance the competitiveness of innovative firms, which can lead to increased productivity and economic growth.

reforms.description: The federal government provides enhanced refundable Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) tax credits to Canadian Controlled Private Companies (CCPCs) with qualifying annual R&D expenditures.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By providing substantial tax credits for R&D, the program incentivizes firms to invest in innovation, which can lead to increased productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Canadian governments provide enhanced (refundable) Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) tax credits.
reforms.importance_rationale: The SR&ED tax credit program is a significant mechanism for encouraging R&D investment among small and medium-sized enterprises, which is vital for fostering innovation.
reforms.source_quote: Canadian governments provide enhanced (refundable) Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) tax credits to Canadian Controlled Private Companies (CCPCs) with qualifying annual R&D expenditure up to CAD 3 million.

reforms.description: The 2016 federal budget increases funding for the Industrial Research Assistance Program by CAD 50 million in 2016-17, building on previous increases, to support innovation networks and clusters.

reforms.source_quote: The 2016 federal budget increases funding for the Industrial Research Assistance Program by CAD 50 million in 2016-17.

reforms.source_quote: The federal government is working with the provinces and territories to implement a pan-Canadian framework for clean growth and climate change by early 2017.

reforms.source_quote: The federal government has also recently announced CAD 2 billion for the creation of the Low Carbon Economy Fund, which will support provincial and territorial actions to address climate change.

reforms.description: The BDC's Growth and Transition Capital programme targets high-potential firms needing financing to sustain growth or transition between owners, addressing capital market failures by providing riskier debt and equity-like investments.

reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By providing financing for projects too risky for conventional debt, the programme supports the growth of innovative firms, potentially enhancing overall economic productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The programme is actively providing financing to high-potential firms.
reforms.importance_rationale: The programme addresses a specific gap in the financing landscape for high-risk firms, contributing to the dynamism of the small business sector.
reforms.source_quote: The BDC’s Growth and Transition Capital programme targets high-potential firms that need financing to sustain growth or to transition between owners.

reforms.importance_rationale: The VCAP represents a significant investment in the venture capital sector, aiming to revitalize and expand the availability of capital for innovative firms.
reforms.source_quote: The federal government announced the Venture Capital Action Plan (VCAP) in January 2013 to boost the venture capital industry.
